description: Telegram handlers must not import models or repositories — use services
fix: Telegram handlers call backend services. No direct data layer access.

description: Client handlers must not make direct HTTP calls — use backend services
fix: Clients call backend services directly (in-process). HTTP calls belong in gateway or service adapters.

description: API endpoints must not contain multi-service orchestration (asyncio.gather)
fix: Move orchestration logic to a service method. Endpoints parse input, call one service, render output.

description: TUI screens must not import models or repositories — use services
fix: TUI screens call backend services. No direct data layer access.

description: Clients must not create database sessions directly — use service factory()
fix: Use ServiceClass.factory() or inject sessions via dependency. Clients never manage DB sessions.

description: Frontend API layer must not contain business logic transforms
expect: API client methods return server responses as-is. Transforms happen in backend services.
fix: Move data transforms to backend service response builders. Frontend API layer is passthrough.
